House uses it two ways: interactively (the coordinator or the human asks for a second opinion), and as the basis of
`house review`, which reimplements its rules headlessly (sole-reviewer brief without trigger phrases, read-only
Codex sandbox, liveness check, output verified to be a review and not an apology).
